rationale: This mutation bridges the $11k cash deficit by scaling plot capacity to 16-18 plots synchronized with full 10-hand hiring by Day 16-18, expanding the compounding Strawberry footprint while creating a 3-4 plot auxiliary buffer dedicated to Town Shop contracts. It enforces strict Strawberry Acreage Sovereignty to permanently prevent tilling mature perennial bushes for one-off shop demands, establishes realistic shop seed phase-gates (halting Pumpkins Day 20, Tomatoes Day 23, Carrots Day 26) to maximize premium contract revenue without late-game crop stranding, and purges phantom wheat hoarding when livestock is zero. Routine liquidation price floors are tightened to >=0.90x base (dropping to >=0.80x only under shed congestion) to eliminate severe margin leakage while maintaining essential capital velocity, and fertilizer application is formally integrated into farm execution while preserving immediate on-site watering to prevent growth pauses.
